title: Overhaul Mobile Mode Shell Chrome
description:
Mobile mode (viewport ≤767px) is massively incomplete: navbar/footer still render all six per-anchor PanelChromeTabBars plus the fullscreen toggle, the merged MobilePanel is a fixed 260px strip instead of filling the screen, windows keep their Focus/maximize control, and panes stay draggable/resizable/foldable.

Target: navbar shows only logo+title and a single "Panel" toggle top-right; toggling opens the merged panel to fill the full space between navbar and footer (canvas hidden but mounted); footer keeps brand credits but drops its tab bars; windows lose the Focus control (always full space, Close stays); the 8-anchor Pane API becomes fixed (no drag/resize/fold) on mobile; no document-fullscreen toggle on mobile. Example selector and mode switcher move into a synthetic "App" tab inside the mobile panel.

Implementation plan (approved, see full plan for exact regions/line numbers):
- ui/js/react/index.tsx: add UiMobileProvider/useUiMobile context+hook; Layout mobile branch fills MobilePanel to flex-1 and hides (not unmounts) canvas; MobilePanel drops fixed height; Pane reads useUiMobile to disable drag/resize/fold; Mode/ModeDockTabBar hides Focus control on mobile (Close stays); Window suppresses focus control via useUiMobile; add ui.mobilePanel.toggle/app i18n keys (EN/DE) + resolveControlLabelId branch.
- framework/renderer/react/index.tsx (FrameworkOsShell): add dedicated unpersisted mobilePanelVisible state + SET_MOBILE_PANEL_VISIBLE action, route all mobile-relevant panel-visibility writers (hotkeys, command palette, introduction, details/studio override effects) through it instead of the derived "any anchor visible"; mobile-only navbarItems branch (logo+title + single Panel toggle, no tab bars/fullscreen/example/mode); append example selector + mode switcher as a synthetic "App" tree leaf to mobilePanelTabs on mobile; mobile-only footerItems branch (credits only, no tab bars); showFullscreenToggle={!mobile}.
- Extend existing stories (.storybook/stories/ui/MobilePanel.stories.tsx, Layout.stories.tsx — add Mobile story) and inline vitest blocks in ui/js/react/index.tsx (Mode mobile, Pane, Shell components describes) — no new files.

Verification: bunx vitest run on ui/js/react/index.tsx; Storybook check; runtime check via OS shell dev server at 375x812 viewport confirming all 6 target behaviors plus no WebGL context loss when toggling canvas visibility and correct desktop restoration above 767px.
summary:
Follow-up to the mobile mode overhaul: on mobile, the two footer partner-credit items now show only their logos, dropping the surrounding text ("Ein Projekt von"/"und"/"A project of"/"and" and "Funded by"/"Gefördert durch") since mobile footer space is tight.

Added an `iconOnly` parameter (default `false`, so all existing desktop callers are unaffected) to `aProjectOfLuhUdkFooterItem` and `fundedByZukunftBauFooterItem` in ui/js/react/index.tsx that conditionally omits the text spans while keeping both logos and their outbound links. Wired `mobile` through as that flag at the two call sites in framework/renderer/react/index.tsx's `footerItems` memo (already gated on `mobile` from the prior overhaul work). Extended the existing "uses normal shell edges..." inline vitest test with iconOnly assertions (text absent, logos/links still present).

Verified via targeted vitest run (`-t "uses normal shell edges"`): 1/1 passed.
